images.title: What an AI Employee handles, *role by role*
head: Role
What the AI Employee handles
What it hands to a person
rows: Receptionist
Answers every call and text, books and reschedules, answers common questions, takes messages
Upset customers, unusual requests, anything needing a judgment call
Customer support rep
Answers tickets and emails, tracks orders, processes routine returns, updates records
Refunds above a set amount, complaints, policy exceptions
Scheduler or dispatcher
Fills the calendar, assigns jobs by availability and location, sends confirmations and reminders
Emergencies outside the rules, schedule conflicts it can't resolve
Bookkeeper or AP clerk
Enters bills and receipts, matches transactions, chases overdue invoices, prepares reports
Approving payments, anything unusual in the numbers
Executive assistant
Manages the inbox and calendar, drafts replies, preps meeting notes, tracks follow-ups
Sending anything sensitive, decisions on your behalf
Inside sales rep
Responds to new leads in minutes, qualifies them, books calls, follows up on quotes
The sales conversation itself, pricing negotiations
Office administrator
Data entry, document filing, form processing, vendor emails, weekly reporting
Contracts, hiring, anything with legal weight
Marketing coordinator
Drafts posts and newsletters, schedules content, reports on results, updates listings
Brand decisions, final approval on what goes public
Data analyst
Pulls data from your systems, builds recurring reports, flags trends and outliers
Interpreting results for big decisions
